aif:spec:maximumOperatingCondenserLiquid.Parameter: Maximum operating condenser liquid volumetric flow rate
aif:spec:maximumOperatingCondenserLiquid.Description: Maximum condenser liquid volumetric flow rate for valid operation. Keep consistent with the performance-map safe operating envelope; applies when equipment flow limits are declared.

aif:spec:minimumOperatingCondenserLiquid.Parameter: Minimum operating condenser liquid volumetric flow rate
aif:spec:minimumOperatingCondenserLiquid.Description: Minimum condenser liquid volumetric flow rate for valid operation. Keep consistent with the performance-map safe operating envelope; applies when equipment flow limits are declared.

aif:spec:condenserNominalPipeOutsideDiam.Description: Condenser connection pipe outside diameter. Separate from the internal bore; applies when nominal pipe dimensions are provided.

aif:spec:evaporatorLeavingTemperatureSet.Description: Maximum permitted evaporator leaving-temperature setpoint. Keep consistent with the performance-map safe operating envelope. Applicability condition pending review.
Minimum permitted evaporator leaving-temperature setpoint. Keep consistent with the performance-map safe operating envelope. Applicability condition pending review.

aif:spec:maximumOperatingEvaporatorLiqui.Description: Maximum permitted evaporator liquid volumetric flow rate. Keep consistent with the performance-map safe operating envelope. Applicability condition pending review.

aif:spec:minimumOperatingEvaporatorLiqui.Description: Minimum permitted evaporator liquid volumetric flow rate. Keep consistent with the performance-map safe operating envelope. Applicability condition pending review.

aif:spec:evaporatorNominalPipeOutsideDia.Description: Evaporator nominal pipe OD. Applicability condition pending review.

aif:spec:referenceNetEvaporatorCapacity_.Description: Net evaporator cooling capacity at the declared reference operating point. Net capacity boundary remains open; legacy aliases require an explicit unit and boundary mapping.

aif:spec:condenserLiquidType.Description: Condenser liquid type; concentration is stored separately.

aif:spec:referenceCOP.Description: Rated cooling coefficient of performance at the declared design point.

aif:spec:evaporatorLiquidType.Description: Evaporator liquid type; concentration is stored separately.

aif:spec:referenceInputPower_W.Description: Equipment input power at the declared reference operating point. Total-unit input boundary remains open; legacy aliases require an explicit unit and boundary mapping.

aif:spec:numberOfCompressors.Description: Installed compressor count; the number currently running is a separate operating value.

aif:spec:refrigerant.Description: Refrigerant designation beginning with R-, such as R-134a.

aif:spec:iplv_kWPerTon.Description: Integrated part-load efficiency rating. Rating standard, conditions and refrigeration-ton basis remain open.

aif:spec:nplv_kWPerTon.Description: Non-standard part-load efficiency rating. Rating standard, conditions and refrigeration-ton basis remain open.

aif:spec:communicationProtocol.Description: Configured communication protocol. Vocabulary and cardinality remain open.

aif:spec:soundPowerLevel_dBA.Description: Declared acoustic rating. Sound power versus sound pressure, reference, weighting and test conditions remain open.

aif:spec:hotGasBypassInstalled.Description: Flag indicating whether a hot-gas bypass valve is installed. Applicability condition pending review.

aif:spec:condenserType.Description: Condenser type for the liquid-cooled representation.

aif:spec:evaporatorLiquidMassFraction_kg.Description: Evaporator liquid mass fraction with bounds >= 0.0 and <= 1.0. Water and mixture conventions remain open.

aif:spec:condenserLiquidMassFraction_kgP.Description: Condenser liquid mass fraction with bounds >= 0.0 and <= 1.0. Water fraction denotes the declared water component; mixture-component convention must be documented.

aif:spec:evaporatorFoulingFactor_m2KPerW.Description: Evaporator fouling factor with bounds >= 0.0. Applicability condition pending review.

aif:spec:condenserFoulingFactor_m2KPerW.Description: RS0001 condenser fouling factor with bounds >= 0.0. Applies when a condenser fouling allowance is declared.

aif:spec:cyclingDegradationCoefficient.Description: Cycling degradation coefficient with bounds >= 0.0 and <= 1.0. Applicability condition pending review.

aif:spec:performanceModelType.Description: Performance data representation for the liquid-cooled chiller.

aif:spec:performanceModelSource.Description: Name of the program or specification supplying the authored performance model.

aif:spec:performanceModelVersion.Description: Version of the program or specification supplying the authored performance model.

aif:spec:performanceModelComponent.Description: Component identity within the declared performance-model source.

aif:spec:referenceNetCondenserCapacity_W.Description: Reference net condenser capacity. Authored rating or reference condition; time-varying operating values are separate.

aif:spec:referenceOilCoolerHeat_W.Description: Reference oil cooler heat. Authored rating or reference condition; time-varying operating values are separate. Applicability condition pending review.

aif:spec:referenceAuxiliaryHeat_W.Description: Reference auxiliary heat. Authored rating or reference condition; time-varying operating values are separate. Applicability condition pending review.

aif:spec:referenceCoolingMapPointIndex.Description: Zero-based flat index of the cooling-map point for the declared reference input power and net evaporator and condenser capacities. Use AM.009 cooling-axis order with the compressor sequence varying fastest. Omit when the ratings do not identify an exact grid point.

aif:spec:performanceMapCoolingGridEvapor.Parameter: Performance map cooling grid evaporator liquid volumetric flow rate
aif:spec:performanceMapCoolingGridEvapor.Description: LIQUID cooling-model axis; applies to TABULAR models. Cartesian-product axis order is evaporator flow, evaporator leaving temperature, condenser flow, condenser entering temperature, compressor sequence; last axis varies fastest.

aif:spec:performanceMapCoolingGridEvapor.Parameter: Performance map cooling grid evaporator liquid leaving temperature

aif:spec:performanceMapCoolingGridConden.Description: LIQUID cooling-model axis; applies to TABULAR models. Cartesian-product axis order is evaporator flow, evaporator leaving temperature, condenser flow, condenser entering temperature, compressor sequence; last axis varies fastest.

aif:spec:performanceMapCoolingLookupInpu.Parameter: Performance map cooling lookup input power
aif:spec:performanceMapCoolingLookupInpu.Description: LIQUID cooling-model result table; applies to TABULAR models. One value per Cartesian-product point in declared axis order.

aif:spec:performanceMapCoolingLookupNetE.Parameter: Performance map cooling lookup net evaporator capacity
aif:spec:performanceMapCoolingLookupNetE.Description: LIQUID cooling-model result table; applies to TABULAR models. One value per Cartesian-product point in declared axis order.

aif:spec:performanceMapCoolingLookupNetC.Description: LIQUID cooling-model result table; applies to TABULAR models. One value per Cartesian-product point in declared axis order.

aif:spec:performanceMapCoolingLookupOilC.Description: LIQUID cooling-model result table; applies to TABULAR models. One value per Cartesian-product point in declared axis order.

aif:spec:performanceMapCoolingLookupAuxi.Description: LIQUID cooling-model result table; applies to TABULAR models. One value per Cartesian-product point in declared axis order.

aif:spec:performanceMapStandbyGridEnviro.Parameter: Performance map standby grid environment dry bulb temperature
aif:spec:performanceMapStandbyGridEnviro.Description: Standby grid variable environment dry bulb temperature. Authored model axis; applies to TABULAR models.

aif:spec:performanceMapStandbyLookupInpu.Parameter: Performance map standby lookup input power
aif:spec:performanceMapStandbyLookupInpu.Description: Standby lookup variable input power. Authored model result table; applies to TABULAR models.

aif:spec:performanceMapEvaporatorLiquidP.Parameter: Performance map evaporator liquid pressure differential grid evaporator liquid volumetric flow rate
aif:spec:performanceMapEvaporatorLiquidP.Description: Evaporator pressure differential grid variable evaporator liquid volumetric flow rate. Authored model axis; applies to TABULAR models.

aif:spec:performanceMapEvaporatorLiquidP.Parameter: Performance map evaporator liquid pressure differential grid evaporator liquid leaving temperature
aif:spec:performanceMapEvaporatorLiquidP.Description: Evaporator pressure differential grid variable evaporator liquid leaving temperature. Authored model axis; applies to TABULAR models.

aif:spec:performanceMapEvaporatorLiquidP.Parameter: Performance map evaporator liquid pressure differential lookup evaporator liquid differential pressure
aif:spec:performanceMapEvaporatorLiquidP.Description: Evaporator pressure differential lookup variable evaporator liquid differential pressure. Authored model result table; applies to TABULAR models.

aif:spec:performanceMapCondenserLiquidPr.Parameter: Performance map condenser liquid pressure differential grid condenser liquid volumetric flow rate
aif:spec:performanceMapCondenserLiquidPr.Description: Condenser pressure-differential model axis; applies to TABULAR models. Axes are condenser flow then entering temperature; last axis varies fastest.

aif:spec:performanceMapCondenserLiquidPr.Parameter: Performance map condenser liquid pressure differential grid condenser liquid entering temperature
